sec.title: August 28 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 285)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 28** across American network radio, BBC Radio 4, and syndicated transcriptions, three Western adventures of *The Cisco Kid* (1952, 1956, 1958) starring Jack Mather, Harry Lang, and Mel Blanc, Chester Stratton in *Hop Harrigan*, Michael Hordern & Richard Briers in P.G. Wodehouse's *Joy in the Morning*, and Bob Nolan with The Sons of the Pioneers on *The 10-2-4 Ranch* for Dr. Pepper (1945–1973):
